name: Adaptive Atomic ReduCtion Software (ARC-SW)
definition: A software-only implementation of ARC that leverages existing warp-level primitives (such as `shfl`) to implement warp-level reduction at each SM sub-core. It uses a balancing threshold to decide whether to reduce at the SM or send to ROP units.
summary: ARC-SW is a software-only framework that accelerates gradient computation in differentiable rendering by dynamically selecting between atomic addition and warp-level reduction to minimize GPU bottlenecks.
